Table 1 from the document "Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials" (cssc-2020) is:

| Compound | δd [MPa]^1/2 | δp [MPa]^1/2 | δh [MPa]^1/2 | Ra [MPa]^1/2 |
| PVDF | 17.2 | 12.5 | 9.2 | – |
| NMP | 18.4 | 12.3 | 7.2 | 2.3 |
| DMF | 17.4 | 13.7 | 11.3 | 2.4 |
| EG | 17.0 | 11.0 | 26.0 | 16.9 |

The hydrogen-bonding parameter δh for ethylene glycol (EG) is 26.0 MPa^1/2, and for PVDF is 9.2 MPa^1/2. Therefore, EG's δh is approximately 2.83 times larger than PVDF's.

NMP's Ra is 2.3 and EG's Ra is 16.9. Therefore, EG's Ra is approximately 7.3 times larger than NMP's Ra.
